Evidence & scope

The exact inspected paper version has separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI reviews. Each dossier separately examines methods, main results or worked examples, and limitations, with explicit source spans and unknowns. Full-source depth means that bounded source-content examination, not whole-document, appendix, proof, model-run, corpus, legal or operational verification. Each distinct work contributes at most once; version children and related artifact mentions add no extra paper, dataset or benchmark coverage.
